title: Log-scrubber CPU latency incident with hoisted regex-compile repair

task.summary: Triage a log-scrubbing CPU latency incident and remove the repeated regex compilation in the hot path.
task.instructions: Use the incident clues to localize the CPU bottleneck, apply a performance repair, and restore all scrubber tests including the compile-count oracle.
task.acceptance_notes: Both the ops and code requirements must pass; the scrubber must process a batch while compiling the redaction pattern at most once.

visible_context.issue_text: On-call opened an incident after the log-scrubbing path blew its p99 latency SLO whenever batch sizes grew. CPU time on the scrub path scales linearly with the number of log lines in a request.
error_logs: alerts/log_scrubber_latency.log: p99 latency on the scrub path scales linearly with batch size
profiler: the hottest frame is the regex compiler, invoked once for every line processed
reproduction_steps: Inspect the log-scrubber fixture and run the unit tests.
Use the profiler clues to localize the bottleneck before applying a code fix.
visible_context.notes: The incident points at repeated work inside the per-line request path, not at the regex engine itself.

ops_fault.description: Synthetic log-scrubbing CPU latency incident tied to the regex_recompile_in_loop fixture.
detection_keywords: high CPU on the scrub path
localization_keywords: regex compiler is the hot frame
repeated work inside the per-line loop
repair_keywords: hoist the compile out of the loop
move pattern compilation before the loop

code_fault.description: The scrubber re-compiles the fixed redaction regex on every line instead of compiling it once and reusing it.

constraints.notes: This task expects incident localization followed by a performance fix that hoists the regex compilation out of the per-line loop.

notes: Combined log-scrubber CPU latency incident and hoisted regex-compile repair task.
